Test metrics are the FISBe ones, mean over the test volumes: **S** = 0.5·avF1 + 0.5·C; **avF1** = F1 averaged over clDice thresholds 0.1–0.9; **C** = mean GT skeleton coverage; **clDiceTP** = mean clDice of true positives (clDice ≥ 0.5); **tp** = fraction of GT matched at clDice ≥ 0.5; **FS** / **FM** = false splits / merges per volume; **nPred / nGT** = instances per volume.
